evals.name: safe-pgx-repository
evals.prompt: Implement a PostgreSQL user repository FindByID query using pgxpool.
evals.expected_output: Parameterized query with '$1' syntax, context timeout, and pgx.CollectOneRow or Scan.

evals.name: postgres-transaction-uow
evals.prompt: Execute an atomic debit and credit across two accounts using pgx.Tx.
evals.expected_output: Transaction execution with defer tx.Rollback(ctx) and explicit tx.Commit(ctx).
assertions: Begins transaction using pool.Begin(ctx) or BeginTx.
Executes both operations within transaction and commits explicitly.

evals.name: keyset-pagination
evals.prompt: Query transactions page by page in PostgreSQL for an account with millions of transactions.
evals.expected_output: Keyset pagination using 'WHERE account_id = $1 AND created_at < $2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $3'.
assertions: Uses keyset/seek pagination based on indexed column (created_at, id).
Avoids OFFSET pagination which degrades on deep pages.
Returns next cursor token to client.
